messages:
mina: dropped a Figma file with a few dark-mode explorations — trying to avoid 'glow' while keeping small UI labels legible. link + two screenshots attached.

felix: nice! immediately: metric microcopy at 11-12px is the pain point. would rather not bump global type scale; can we tweak the label color and/or weight? also legends in charts feel cramped.

anya: quick palette attempt (devs, these are tokens you can try):
```css
:root {
  --bg: #060708; /* canvas */
  --panel: #0b0f11; /* panels */
  --card: #0d1113; /* cards */
  --text-1: #e7eef3; /* body */
  --text-2: #c7d6dd; /* small/labels */
}
/* chart set (lower saturation, stepped luminance) */
--chart-colors: #6fa9ff, #7ed3ac, #f6c77d, #b99bff, #ff8d88;
```
keeping muted at #c7d6dd should hit ~4.6:1 vs panel (good for 12px).

sam: on code blocks and inline tokens 121212 small token colors lose definition. propose two things: 1) slightly darker background for inline code (`background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03)`) and 2) subtle micro-outline `text-shadow: 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)` for tokens under 13px. avoids pumping saturation.

mina: good call. also debating whether chart grid lines should be warmer or cooler to aid separability. warmer grids make orange-ish series pop less. cooler grids make blues blend. leaning toward neutral-cool grid `#0b1013` at 12% opacity.

felix: UX nit on the toggle copy: current heading is "Colorblind mode" which feels narrow. suggestion: "Color accessibility: improve visual distinction for color differences". short label next to toggle: "Accessibility palette". this matches other settings copy.

anya: added a compact legend prototype — increases touch target for legend items and uses 13px text with 6px spacing. also added an icon-only collapse for dense charts.

mina: a11y-bot, run contrast checks on the new tokens?

a11y-bot: automated scan results (summary):
- text-1 (#e7eef3) vs panel (#0b0f11): 7.9:1 (PASS)
- text-2 (#c7d6dd) vs panel (#0b0f11): 4.6:1 (PASS for 12px)
- chart color #6fa9ff vs panel: 4.1:1 (PASS borderline for sub-12 labels)
- chart color #ff8d88 vs panel: 3.0:1 (FAIL for small labels)
- inline token bg rgba(255,255,255,0.03) on panel: visually tested, effective; recommend `text-shadow` fallback for older browsers.
Recommendation: adjust #ff8d88 -> #ff9a9a or add 1px halo for that series. consider shipping "Accessibility palette" toggle default off but recommended in settings with copy from Felix above.

sam: to capture implementation details 121212
- update `--text-2` to #c7d6dd
- legend font-size -> 13px, legend item padding -> 6px
- chart colors array -> try `['#6fa9ff','#7ed3ac','#f6c77d','#b99bff','#ff9a9a']`
- inline token: add `text-shadow` fallback and slightly darker inline bg for <13px
I'll open a tiny PR with CSS variables and a demo page.

mina: perfect. design will push mocks for: small-size legend, accessibility palette toggle copy, and syntax token variants (normal / high contrast) by EOD. thanks all :heart:
